notes.title: First Strike 7 Year Anniversary Remaster Update
notes.content:
Hello all fans of Blindflug Studios

First Strike, the nuclear war game, which was also the game that founded our studio, will have a major milestone this week: It is turning seven years old!

To celebrate, we gave it a special treatment as a game: it got a complete remaster. The new First Strike is faster, sleeker and more cunning, but still has the old bombastic gameplay that made it such a hit for us.

Check it out, we also have a nice discount going for its celebration as well as a livestream on Saturday 13th of March on 7PM CET.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/587000/First_Strike_Final_Hour/]Check out First Strike: Classic[/url]

So Happy Birthday First Strike! Never stop nuking the world!

notes.title: Sale for a big cause and major difficulty update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

First of all, we wanted to announce, that Airheart is participating for a great sale this week for #DayOfTheGirl

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/eec27d6d79539ae3edf64e6a0dad26d6a9897d99.jpg[/img]

Airheart and all its DLC is discounted 33% right now, and 50% of the profit is going directly to Warchild UK in their endevours to protect and support children affected by war.

We are really proud to be part of this amazing sale which is majorly supported by steam itself. On the sale page are a ton of great games with female leads such as Tacoma, Gone Home, Transistor or Her Story. If you havent had a chance to grab these titles, do it now and support a great cause ːsteamhappyː

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/dayofthegirl/] Day Of The Girl Sales Page [/url]


[h1]First Major Update[/h1]

To commemorate this occasion we also launched the biggest patch since launch today.

- [b] New Difficulty Mode [/b]
Lots of people reported us that the original difficulty was too hard for them to enjoy the game. From today you have a new option when starting a new game. It removes permadeatch, adjust HP and damages and you will never lose airplane parts when crashing on Granaria.

[b]However, It is still possible to lose one or two parts if your crash outside of Granaria, so make sure you dont miss the city![/b] but it will no longer delete your save game so everything else you left at home is safe forever.

If you liked the hard setting: Don't worry. The Airplane Pioneer Mode is the original hard difficulty that you are used to!

- [b] New Crafting Tutorial [/b]
To really explain our tinkering based crafting system, you can now do a new small crafting overview that will lead you step by step to your first gun. 

Complete it to be able to start the game with a machine gun right away. Or just skip it if you are an experienced pioneer.

- [b] Lots of bugfixes and performance improvements [/b]
From all your feedback we were able to indentify a ton of small issues in the game, which should help making the game not only smoother but with less issues. Thanks for everyone who helped with the reports!

We hope you like the new additions to the game

See you next time!
- The Blindflug Team

notes.title: Last early access update before official release. Lots of new content!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Good news! It took a while, but we are now ready to finally update Early Access with our current status. We’ve been working the last 3 months to finish all content of Airheart and make it better than ever before. We really hope you’ll like what you’ll see. 

Here is a list of all the major changes

[h1]Two brand new airplanes and 6 new weapons[/h1] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/7af9322384cf649ffce9eb999dfaba33ca228fa9.png[/img]
The Pinty Woodpecker Fisher plane and the Dunne Daredevil high-end plane are now in the game, giving two new options in the low- and high-end of the cost spectrum. Also we now have 6 new weapons in the game, bringing the total to 25.

[h1]Elite drones and third boss:[/h1] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/d6fa2f669159d1f8db08d7de31b76ca37ad74cfb.png[/img]
As with pirates, the game now has silver and gold elite drones, which can spawn great rewards, but are way tougher to defeat. Also, on level 12 you can finally battle the third boss, that has been teased in the last update.

[h1]More interesting ecosystem[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/d6b39e4d7ad93a7482f51576546b8412d8d98a88.png[/img]
Fish now don’t just disappear when you catch them, but they also get replaced by secondary species, like jellyfish, salp, kryll or sea urchins (depending on the sky layer). Most of these are not valuable, but a danger to your quest.

[h1]More advanced plane AI[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/1f94bd2d0b93d95b0508f98c4ca3de1471084d58.png[/img]
The battles you fight should be a lot more interesting now, that the AI will actually calculate flight path to attack you from desired angles. Also, the fractions of the game will now more often fight out their fights among them, making of for tense battlefields, especially in Autumn Forest.

[h1]Brand new crafting system[/h1] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/0257d252d7a10abaf474422c74a8fc693a668427.png[/img]
The old crafting system felt really grindy, having you to shoot dozens of enemies to finally get the required amount of parts to craft a new weapon. We instead made a new crafting system, based on inventions and ideas. You’ll have to use the trash you find to craft useful items like boxes, magazines, scopes or batteries to find out the combinations that make for fully usable airplane parts in the end.

[h1]Multiple weapons and harpoon secondary[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/ed50cb7797ceef917f18733db55e494fb3fb343e.png[/img]
Wings now don't have their secondary weapon anymore, but instead have a slot property, so you can take up to two weapons with you, allowing for interesting combos that make the mine launcher or the nuke much more useful. Since the wings don’t have a secondary weapon anymore, the secondary fire button will now fire the harpoon, allowing for new combos with the rope and the weapons at the same time.

[h1]Tutorial & story screens:[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/5d9d053e977a340b76c09a8a977d1ed421f43305.png[/img]
The game now features a flight test tutorial, that should help new players to accommodate with the ins and outs of the game. Also, the first version of the story screens is now in the game. We are currently making them prettier and are looking to hire a voice actress for Amelia. But it should already help to tie world together.

[h1]Massive performance improvements[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/eb05659a78ed7f2832b41a670717d316ffb85184.png[/img]
The game runs now massively better across all platforms. We’ve rewritten the cloud system and the layer culling system. We also optimised how much performance the AI needs for its calculation. This should assure that the frame-rate is now stable all the way to the end.

[h1]And lots, lots more.[/h1]
But, this isn't our final release! Most importantly - the game doesn't have the ending yet - after the last layer (12th), there is just an empty space, where you can fly freely. ;)
The current status is that this is the version we are submitting into QA for consoles for the full release in the summer. So, since getting this console focused version done as soon as possible, there are a few things to keep in mind here:
[list]
[*][b]Gamepad focus build:[/b]
This is our PS4 master submission, so the focus of the game is purely on gamepad controls. It should be playable with keyboard and mouse, but especially the interface isn't fully tested on it. Of course, we will optimise all of that for the final full PC release, but we wanted you to be able to take a look earlier.

[*][b]UI aspect ratios untested:[/b]
Similarly, the UI is maybe not responding too well to screen aspect ratios aside from 16:9 or 16:10. If you have a really wide monitor (or a 4:3), some screens might produce some ugly overlays of menu items. You can help us tremendously to identify all these quirks, if you send us screenshots in the steam forums.

[*][b]Translations are placeholders:[/b]
The current translations are all automated google translate version. Hence they are absolutely horrible. Getting these into the game helps us to identify, if there are any missing spots. For the full release, the game will of course have professionally translated texts, as well as an UI that reacts according to the different text lengths.

[*][b]Steam achievements, trading cards, big picture mode etc - untested:[/b]
While the game will now track achievements, most of them haven’t been properly configured in Steam yet. So all Steam specific features are to be taken with a bit of caution.
[/list]
Again, thank you all for being among the first to support the game, during its early phase. We hope you like what it turned out to be and that this update can get you excited for the final release

Blindflug Studios

notes.title: Pre-Holiday Update: Backlog done, new designs in work
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Everyone here at Blindflug looks back to 2017 as an incredible year ːsteamhappyː. It was by far the craziest year we've had so far with four game releases!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/be688b5f153bc2692ba37d787962595d146cfe3c.jpg[/img]

[list]
    [*]June: We released [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/587000/First_Strike_Final_Hour/]First Strike: Final Hour[/url], our first real Steam release
    [*]October: We released a point&click heist client game called [url=http://www.entergame.ch/en/]Enter[/url] on Mobile
    [*]November: We released [url=http://www.reformatzgame.ch](re)format Z:[/url], a free stealth cyberpunk game for Mobile
    [*]December: We finally finished the last step and released [url=http://www.firststrikefinalhour.com]First Strike: Final Hour[/url] also on mobile.
[/list]

Needless to say, that was pretty tough ːfsmadskullː. We were used to do 1-2 releases a year and we're incredibly proud that our small team managed all that. 

Meanwhile, we used as much of the little downtime that we had, to prepare the systems Airheart, which will now be our [b]next game on the release timeline[/b].

[list]
    [*]We made a localising system so the game will be out in as many native languages as possible
    [*]We prepared the achievement system to be filled with content for Steam Achievements and PS4 trophies
    [*]Loading times and AI performance was improved drastically to have less hickups and ugly stuttering.
    [*]We replaced and reworked the game controls system, mainy as a preparation to support Steam controllers and consoles.
    [*]We reworked our Cloud system to be less taxing and optimised for bigger distances. This was also needed for consoles.
    [*]We aquired several dev kits and ported and tested Airheart on three consoles. It looks very promising.
    [*]We've shown Airheart at Tokyo Game Show, Game Happens Italy, Digital Dragons Poland, Nordic Game Conference Sweden and TwitchCon in the USA to gather as much feedback to find out all its flaws for the final features of the game.
[/list]

Most of these features arent fancy or stable anough to varrant a proper update for now, but will roll in as soon as the newest gameplay features are ready.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/ebc3b48fa58b36299b81736996ce24a00ba30ae2.jpg[/img]

All of us are working on the game right now and will continue well into next year. We are testing new enemies and designs. We also have founds an awesome partner that we have to deliver the game to in the forseeable future. Without telling any names, the PC and Console Versions have to hit their Gold Masters by the end of April, which is the current timeline we are working on. 

For all of you, there will be about 2 updates of the Early Access builds towards that release, but the major milestone will be the full release after that in the end of spring.

With all our backlog in the bag, its awesome to be able to get back to our passion project now and I hope you will love the new stuff we have in store for next year.

[b]Happy holidays everyone. See you in 2018![/b]

notes.title: Update VI: 'Tweaking the Engine' is released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/524b269fd5d444548db2c2fac0978a184f74fd81.png[/img]

[h1]Broadcast of all contents in this Update[/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=poVHXJP75Qk] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/f6ee5296dd766065136006b33ccf28d76dd0a9e2.png[/img]
Watch it on Youtube[/url]

We did some spring cleaning and made the game work better. Some of you reported frame rate issues and we took care of that. Hope now you will have even more fun while playing!
There are also some new creatures in the sky. 

[h1]Performance boost[/h1]
We optimized memory handling. The gameplay is definitely more smooth now.

[h1]Sea turtle[/h1]
Catching it is tricky - try it!

[h1]Firefish[/h1]
It wouldn't be scary in the ocean, but in the sky - it is. 

[h1]Damselfish[/h1]
It attracts other fish. Try to keep it on your harpoon for a while...

[h1]Downtint shaders[/h1]
It should be more clear now, what is in your current layer and what is below.

[h1]Harpoon improvements[/h1]
Using harpoon is now a much better experience.

[h1]AI improvements[/h1]
Pirates are still not the brightest bulbs in the sky, but they are learning.

Let us know, how do you like the new update!

notes.title: Update V: 'Friends in High Places' is released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/7e8c716d0da702ca5eab3f5e5c9bea4948802c30.png[/img]

[h1]Broadcast of all contents in this Update[/h1]
[url=https://youtu.be/4Bz02bM4B-M] 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/247a29698492e6a6616ccc2b6f639200d7a4b52e.png[/img]
Watch it on Youtube[/url]

There are some new flying machines in the sky: Fishers, Trading Zeppelin and Fortune Hunters. Try to be nice around them, if you don't want to meet the Granaria Police!

[h1]Fisher[/h1]
Fishing is more competitive now - catch the fish before others do! When they decide they have enough, they go back to Granaria.

[h1]Cargo Zeppelin[/h1]
They transport a really valuable cargo and they will protect it, so think twice before attacking it!

[h1]Fortune Hunters[/h1]
Just like you, they are dreaming about big catch, money and fame. 

[h1]Granaria Police[/h1]
If you think you can just attack fishers and take there oil, you are wrong. Granaria Police watches you!

[h1]Progress Visualization[/h1]
Behold your boss-trophies, your weapons, barrels of oil and blueprints on your wall. Now you can really fell, that the hangar is all yours!

[h1]Skins[/h1]
If you can't afford a new airplane, just try some new colors. 

[h1]Rebalancing[/h1]
It shouldn't be that hard to get a good stuff now.

Progress wiped, but for a good cause.

Let us know, how do you like the new update!

Behold your boss-trophies, your weapons, barrels of oil and blueprints on your wall. Now you can really fell, that the hangar is all yours!
If you can't afford a new airplane, just try some new colors.

notes.title: Update IV: 'Aces in the Sky' is released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/5ac1c9cb2838ce77d67cee7fd93f94667f1985d8.jpg[/img]
[h1]Broadcast of all contents in this Update[/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9EDPI1UtUBg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/12630a895ec15d952dcaf7de970176e6499b8848.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9EDPI1UtUBg]Watch it on youtube[/url]

Not only Amelia can get stronger, so might the Pirates. New Ace Pirates are joining the fight. Here are this update details:

[h1]Aldasoro Corsair LT[/h1]
The brand new airplane from luxury manufacturer Aldasoro is here. With Powerup Attractors, Defense Drones and a Shield it is elegant, expensive, fast and deadly!

[h1]Burnt Black Ace Pirates[/h1]
If a pirate survived several encounters in the battlefield, fight in their battlescarred burnt black planes. Expect heavy resistance from them.

[h1]Blood Red Ace Pirates[/h1]
Pray that you never encounter the deadliest pirates of them all. Their fire painted machines sport incredible weapons and the highest difficulty.

[h1]Golden Trees[/h1]
In every level, there is a tree that will give you a health pack if you find it and fly through it. So if you are low on health, be sure to search the elusive golden tree.

[h1]Flamethrower[/h1]
Has been in the making for a while, now it is finally here: the Flamethrower.

[h1]Mine Launcher[/h1]
The Mine Launcher lets you strategically place a mines in the level. but watch out, they could hurt you as well!

[h1]Controller Rumble[/h1]
If you have a Gamepad with Rumble support you can now feel every shot, pickup and bump. This is immersion on a whole new level!

[h1]Crosshair Colors[/h1]
Sometimes, the Crosshair can be a bit hard to see, so we offer you now multiple new fancy colors!

[h1]Health Bar Colors[/h1]
The Health Bar of planes and enemies got another overhaul. Nice segments in cool colors make judging an enemies health much easier now

[h1]Rebalanced Levels[/h1]
We’ve made the standard enemies and first levels a bit easier to accommodate new players to an easier difficulty. Its will ramp up fast in Autumn Forest again and the chance for enemy aces still persists .

How do you like the new update? Let us know!

notes.title: Update III: 'Raising the Altitude' is released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/bcc7035c0de16f6b1f6369e0af9c056f1e100257.jpg[/img]
[h1]Broadcast of all contents in this Update[/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bab05abK_5o][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/56d0f43a67d00d7066fb1cbba64ee999691a7197.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bab05abK_5o]Watch it on youtube[/url]

Amelia can go higher now - there are new layers available! The most important features of this update are:

[h1]Snowcrest levels[/h1]
Take your jacket on and explore new snowy levels. Perfect for Christmas time.

[h1]Crystals[/h1]
Be aware of red ones - they are pretty, but also pretty dangerous.

[h1]Fractions[/h1]
Security drones won’t tolerate pirates anymore. Use the antagonism between the fractions for your advantage.

[h1]B.O.L.O.[/h1]
Boss Only Lives Once. If you defeat the boss, it won't spawn in your next runs. If you want to see it again... well, you have to crash on the dessert.

[h1]New fish behavior[/h1]
Fish are smarter now. With the new AI they swim in swarms and are not so easy to catch.

[h1]Screenshot mode[/h1]
Catch your best moments and share them with friends. Or just watch them alone. Whatever you like better. Just press F12 and behold the perfect shots of the gun shots.

[h1]Rebalance[/h1]
Since there are new layers pirates can go to, the bottom ones are a bit less crowded.

[h1]Game progress wipe[/h1]
New randomization, new values, new balancing. The universe has changed, so have you. Everything you owned is gone. You have to start anew. But we believe in you! 

How do you like the new update? Let us know!

notes.title: Update II: 'Fishing for Giants' is released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/ea5fe4479c30dfdbc7b63110ef27ce6891346705.jpg[/img]

[h1]Broadcast of all contents in this Update[/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d_VsMO27lIo][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/579dcb5696edb9192827de7a57c4bcea42a8812d.png[/img]
Watch it on YouTube
[/url]

There are some new fish in the sky and hunting them is not so easy - instead of just catching them with your plane you have to use harpoon to drag them to your base on Granaria.
The second update brings also some new features steam community asked for: possibility to use relative controls (instead of default absolute steering), weapon's cooldown visualization, clear indication of health loss, timer for weapons from weapon crate and more! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/9e0f98eadf00e267d654609e5def1cb035b3bc72.png[/img]

[h1]Relative steering[/h1]
One of the big requests for keyboard users was being able to steer the airplane left and right. Player can now switch from direct to relative controls in the options menu.

[h1]First Whale: Minke[/h1]
There has been a rare sighting above Granaria! A Minke whale is roaming the space above the city. Fishermen's dreams have awakened! Who will be the one to defeat the giant and bring it back down?

[h1]Harpoon[/h1]
It is finally here. The most sophisticated hunting machinery for the modern skyfish fisherman.
Anything you shoot at, the harpoon will stick to and you will be able to reel in all those fantastic prizes.

[h1]New fish: Dodolphin[/h1]
A friendly and highly valuable large fish inhabiting the higher skylayers.
Some say it isn’t even a fish, but who knows.

[h1]New fish: Lionfish[/h1]
Feisty territorial competitors of the higher regions. Many fishermen who thought of fish as easy prey have met their end at an swarm of angry Lionfish. 
Likewise, they fetch a great price though.

[h1]New fish: Cratefish[/h1]
Fish, which looks like a healthpack.
Sometimes nature saves creatures from predators by giving them the ability to blend in wonderfully into their environment. A very clever and majestic trick.
This is certainly not the case for the cratefish though.

[h1]Return animation[/h1]
Instead of Amelia just vanishing when returning and crashing, you can now see her getting back down.
Does this help you in any way? Not really... but at least it should make it more clear why you lose your airplane.

[h1]Life ring loss[/h1]
The life rings of enemies and Amelia show now more accurately when life is lost.
Red segments will fly out every time damage is received.

[h1]Weapon cooldown visualization[/h1]
You can now check the cooldown of each weapon in a small reticle around the target cursor.
Unsure when you can use that Skysweeper again? This should help you to perfect that rhythm.

[h1]Game progress wipe[/h1]
New randomization, new values, new balancing. The universe has changed, so have you. Everything you owned is gone. You have to start anew. But we believe in you!

How do you like the new update? Let us know.

The Horizon engine can stop in mid air and the wings have dual machine guns.

More randomisation in the levels, the new Gunmetal Chest gives you a random weapon for 30s and Gunmetal Scouts runs away with Gunmetal Chest and drops Gunmetal Chest if you was able to destroy the scout.

Cruise Missile, Homing Missile, Plasma Launcher, Chronos Cannon, Gauss Launcher, Solar Laser, Lightning Cannon

Blueprints can be crafted from items, they make the gun available in the hardware shop, they don’t get destroyed on game over, there can only be 1 blueprint of the same type and Blueprints now can be sold

What do you think of that update I? Let us know in the related [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/531180/discussions/0/305510202682697448/]Forum Topic[/url].

tags.feature: The Horizon engine can stop in mid air and the wings have dual machine guns.

More randomisation in the levels, the new Gunmetal Chest gives you a random weapon for 30s and Gunmetal Scouts runs away with Gunmetal Chest and drops Gunmetal Chest if you was able to destroy the scout.
Cruise Missile, Homing Missile, Plasma Launcher, Chronos Cannon, Gauss Launcher, Solar Laser, Lightning Cannon

Blueprints can be crafted from items, they make the gun available in the hardware shop, they don’t get destroyed on game over, there can only be 1 blueprint of the same type and Blueprints now can be sold
Changelog shows stacks of cards of new features
Changelog can be seen again in the updates screen

notes.title: Airheart Update I: Fall of the Armory (03.11.2016)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26498298/6464500da1a273fefc6a2488ddde3f69503284db.png[/img]

Airhearts next update is called: [b]Fall of the Armory[/b]
Fall of the Armory will launch on the [b]3rd of November[/b]

[h1]Breaking News[/h1]

Pirates managed to shoot down a giant cargo zeppelin of Gunmetal Ltd in the sky layers above Granaria. Masses of shot down high-tech weaponry descended from the skies, most unusable and the few intact guns left, being swooped up as fast as possible. But there are still remains left all over the sky. And with that newfound knowledge, Amelia and the rest of Granarias underside can now try to craft new, unusual weapons.

[h1]Coming Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]new airplane[/b]: fly in the GATI Horizon
[*][b]new weapons[/b]: unlock new high-tech weaponry
[*][b]blueprints[/b]: unlocking weapons for future playthroughs
[*][b]new pickup[/b]: a new type of chest from Gunmetal Ltd
[*][b]and much more![/b]
[/list]

All details of the update will be streamed by Jeremy Spillmann (Project Lead & Game Design) on 01.11.2016 (16:00 MESZ) on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/blindflugstudio]our Twitch channel[/url]. Tune in for a demonstration of all features.

See you then! :)
